items.title: The full bebu app
items.body: Quick login, caller discovery, voice and video calls, chat, coins and purchases — everything in one build.

items.title: bebu branding
items.body: New icon, name and splash. Same violet look across the app, the website and the console.

items.title: Live on a dedicated server
items.body: The app talks to bebu's own backend over HTTPS, so calls and payments run against real infrastructure.

items.title: Signed release build
items.body: Signed with a release key instead of the debug key, so future updates install over this one.
